title: ATP Protocol Execution Outcome
description: Structured record of a single protocol execution. Used by the staleness review loop to assess protocol quality over time.

execution_phase_reached.description: The furthest phase reached before completion or failure

result.description: success=all phases completed including post-update. partial=execution completed but post-update missed or incomplete. failure=halted before or during execution.

vars_validated.description: Variable IDs that were successfully validated this execution

vars_updated.description: Variable IDs updated in post-execution review

vars_missed_update.description: Variable IDs that should have been updated but were not

escalations_triggered.description: Escalation rule text that fired during this execution

protocol_needed_logged.description: True if this execution resulted in a 'protocol needed' log for a new unmatched pattern

failure_reason.description: Free text description of why execution failed or was partial
